items.text: Validation rule 3 ('the fake is updated in the same commit') broke commit by commit on fix/d1116-budget-all: 1303798 and db706cb changed routes before the fake daemon and real-daemon cases (6d26ea7, b9c1503); the real-daemon suite was red in between. The merged head is consistent. Accepted (session lead decision (C4b-merge)); the merge commit stays (history is pushed and not rewritten).

Bench-only caveat: FORERUNNER_BENCH_USAGE and FORERUNNER_BENCH_CRITIC_USAGE add input tokens after the precheck, so a run they inflate can pass its work cap (real-daemon W15-14: 'after spending CHF 0.12' against a CHF 0.11 work cap). The task's own budget held. LC-C32 records whether a real run ever passes its work cap.

wiring.test.ts now waits up to 30 s for the task's close, which includes the review, instead of the run's return. A slow Windows runner has a review's git and critic work inside that window: watch it on CI; widen with a reason if it flakes.

The BEFORE bench walk on the base 136d4f6 was not made (the auto-mode classifier denied checking the base code into the worktree, and one bench at a time). The before state comes from earlier walks of the same code: /tmp/frbench/fix-l3-money-screens/steps/23-after-tasks-after.png, 24-after-drawer-after.png and /tmp/frbench/fix-d1109-starts-engine/steps/13-after-retry-tasks.png, plus each item's failing test. Accepted.

Continue at a tiny budget adds much more than the budget, because one Continue must give what the task needs (the estimate left plus W, less what is left): CHF 0.004 gave 'Continue (CHF 0.07 more)', CHF 0.008 gave CHF 0.10. By the spec (BA-5, one Continue is enough) and the button names the amount. LC-C32 records how it reads to a person.

for_session_lead.changelog_update_log_line: A task's budget now counts its whole cost: its work, the critic's reviews and any fixes (the owner's answer of 2026-11-16). Each run keeps room for its review, one Continue is enough when a review waits, estimates include the review, and the Tasks row, drawer and Costs show one figure ("of CHF 0.20 budget").
for_session_lead.owner_tunable: REVIEW_STARTING_ESTIMATES_USD_MICRO {1: 30_000, 2: 90_000, 3: 300_000} in packages/runtime/src/estimates/model.ts is the one place to tune the review part of an estimate; REVIEW_EVIDENCE_ALLOWANCE_TOKENS = 8,000 in packages/critic/src/critic.ts sets W.
